verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas ships an official Editor MCP server that lets AI assistants modify project data and verify results via viewport, plus 'PlayCanvas Skills' bundled in new projects giving compatible AI coding agents PlayCanvas-specific workflows, and a scriptable Editor API for automation — together these let an AI-native user drive the editor via natural-language-capable agents rather than raw GUI clicks. However, the evidence doesn't show natural-language commands as a first-party end-user chat interface within the product itself, only agent/MCP integration paths; community evidence is silent on hands-on MCP usage. missing for 10: first-party natural-language command interface within the product UI, independent/community validation of MCP-driven natural-language workflows in practice.
